Ministries

Infants – 6th grade · Sundays

Children’s Ministry

Children’s Church is an integral part of our church. It meets during the Sunday service to introduce children to all the provisions of God’s grace, help them have basic Christian experiences, and help them live a victorious Christian life in readiness for the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ.

Send us a message
Grades 7–12

Youth Ministry

Our Youth Ministry helps young people know Christ, grow in God’s Word, and live for Him at school, at home and among their friends. It grows out of Deeper Life Schools Outreach (DLSO), which began in 1979 with the first-ever Free Vacation School for secondary school students in Lagos State, Nigeria.

Send us a message

On fire for the things of God — no matter the cost.

Young adults

Young Adults Ministry

The Deeper Life Young Adults Ministry challenges young adults to a life of holiness in a world that is anything but holy. We want to see young people on fire for the things of God, ready to do His work. Programs run throughout the year and are announced as they come up.

Find out what’s next
Women

Women’s Ministry

The Deeper Life Women’s Ministry has played a key supporting role in Deeper Christian Life Ministry from the beginning, meeting the spiritual and family needs of women in the church and around the world. Through this ministry, multitudes of women have been saved, restored, sanctified and Spirit-filled.

Send us a message
Men

Men’s Ministry

The Men’s Ministry exists to build men into fully devoted followers of Christ: true disciples who answer His call, “Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men” (Matthew 4:19). Let’s go a-fishing — spread the Word!

Send us a message
Choir & musicians

Music Ministry

Our choir and musicians lead the congregation in worship through hymns, choruses and special songs that honor God and prepare hearts to receive His Word. If you love the Lord and sing or play an instrument, we’d love for you to join us — speak with an usher or send us a message.

Outreach

Serving beyond our walls

Ways we carry the hope of Christ into Lewisville and beyond — and ways you can join in.

  • Evangelism

    Equipped and empowered believers obeying the Great Commission, taking the message of hope to a hopeless world (Matthew 28:19–20).

    Get involved

  • Counseling

    Our Counseling Ministry helps people learn to focus on God, the best Counselor. To speak with a pastor, contact the church.

    Counseling is not a crisis service. If you or someone you know is in danger, call 911, or call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.

    Talk with a pastor

  • Hospital Visitation

    We visit and pray with people in the hospital, bringing them the comfort and hope of Christ.

    Request a visit

  • Community Volunteering

    We serve our neighbors through the Heart of the City food distribution. Dates, times and locations are announced in advance.

    Volunteer with us

  • Prison Ministry

    Taking the hope of the Gospel to men and women in prison.

    Learn more
